canonical_definition:
Space of definitions. Across the available usage, this behavior is described as generating a close approximation of the original unlearned text by exploiting differences in model weights before and after unlearning. In "Textual Unlearning Gives a False Sense of Unlearning," the success criterion is effective reconstruction of the unlearned text, with the paper stating that "the adversary could effectively reconstruct the unlearned texts via continuous constrained optimization" and showing this as "reconstruct unlearned data by W-W’."

Space of elicitation and scores. Papers do not link this behavior to any measurement instrument.

What it is taken as evidence of. Papers do not link this behavior to any construct.
